correctness.rationale: Identified (a,b) with (a+b)+b√2 in Z_2[√2]/(√2)^(2k). The noncancelling norm valuations are v(a+b√2)=min(2ν_2(a+b),1+2ν_2(b)), giving the source Delta. For λ=1+√2, verified v(λ-1)=1, v(λ²-1)=2, v(λ⁴-1)=5, and for s≥2 v(λ^(2^s)-1)=2s+1; odd multiples retain the same valuation. Return requires that unit-power valuation be ≥h=2k-truncated v(state). The shell of height h has 2^(h-1) states and yields exactly the stated cycles by division; k=1,2 and h=0,1,2,3,4,5 checked. Independent direct orbit enumeration k=1..6 gives 3,6,14,30,62,126 cycles, all states covered. Exhaustion for all k is symbolic, not inferred from finite checks.
